name: 狩猎本能·技能
description: 附近敌人使用技能后，葛力姆乔可进行一次狩猎移动。
skillCode: var grimm = context.rulePiece; var enemy = context.sourcePiece; if (!grimm || grimm.currentHp <= 0 || !enemy || enemy.currentHp <= 0 || enemy.ownerPlayerId === grimm.ownerPlayerId || enemy.instanceId === grimm.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (Math.abs(enemy.x - grimm.x) + Math.abs(enemy.y - grimm.y) > 4) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (context.cancelled) return { success: false, message: '' }; var selected = Array.isArray(context.selectedTargets) ? context.selectedTargets : []; var livingAt = function(x, y) { return battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === x && piece.y === y; }); }; if (selected.length === 0) { var cells = battle.map.tiles.filter(function(tile) { return tile.props && tile.props.walkable && Math.abs(tile.x - grimm.x) + Math.abs(tile.y - grimm.y) <= 2 && !(tile.x === grimm.x && tile.y === grimm.y) && !livingAt(tile.x, tile.y); }).sort(function(left, right) { return left.y - right.y || left.x - right.x; }).map(function(tile) { return { type: 'cell', x: tile.x, y: tile.y }; }); if (!cells.length) return { success: false, message: '' }; return { success: false, needsTargetSelection: true, playerId: grimm.ownerPlayerId, title: '狩猎本能：选择落点', targetType: 'cell', filter: 'all', targetCandidates: cells, selectionMode: 'single', minSelections: 1, maxSelections: 1, canCancel: true, resumeOnCancel: true }; } var ref = selected[0]; if (!ref || ref.type !== 'cell') return { success: false, message: '狩猎本能落点无效' }; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === ref.x && item.y === ref.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable || livingAt(ref.x, ref.y) || Math.abs(ref.x - grimm.x) + Math.abs(ref.y - grimm.y) > 2) return { success: false, message: '狩猎本能落点已失效' }; grimm.x = ref.x; grimm.y = ref.y; var hits = 0; if (enemy.currentHp > 0 && Math.abs(enemy.x - grimm.x) + Math.abs(enemy.y - grimm.y) === 1) { for (var index = 0; index < 2; index++) { var activeGrimm = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === grimm.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); var activeEnemy = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === enemy.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); if (!activeGrimm || !activeEnemy) break; dealDamage(activeGrimm, activeEnemy, Math.floor(activeGrimm.attack * 0.75), 'physical', battle, 'grimmjow-hunting-instinct'); hits++; activeGrimm = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === grimm.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); if (activeGrimm) dealDamage(activeGrimm, activeGrimm, 1, 'true', battle, 'grimmjow-destruction-instinct'); } } return { success: true, message: grimm.name + '发动狩猎本能' + (hits ? '并攻击' + hits + '次' : '') };
